fixes.area: small casters cast no visible sun shadow (people, bench, car)
fixes.problem: hero: the white-shirt ped stands in the full sun patch at el 8.9 deg and has no shadow streak, while palms cast long ones. hero_noon (el 77.7): no shadow under the bench seat, and only a faint smudge at ped feet. mends: no player shadow on the jetty. shops: the car has no contact shadow. Every human and street prop floats. avatars.js sets castShadow=true, so the caster pass or the resolution is losing them. The camera-follow box is r=120 m plus maxShadowLen 160 m, which gives ext about 400 m at el 9, so texel is about 0.2 m at 2048. normalBias = texel*1.0 = 0.2 m lifts ground lookups 0.2 m, which shifts low-sun shadows about 1.3 m off the feet. A 0.45 m wide body is 2 texels and the PCF then averages it away.
fixes.fix: Diagnose first, in one frame: tools/qa/one.mjs hero_noon with ?q=ultra (4096 map). If the bench shadow appears there, it is resolution or bias; if not, check the caster pass (InstancedMesh/SkinnedMesh bounding spheres in the shadow frustum; bench and avatar materials not transparent). Then: (a) index.js line 260: G.shadowRadius high 120 -> 80; (b) main.js line 61: maxShadowLen high 160 -> 110; (c) pcss.js fitSunShadow: light.shadow.normalBias = texel*1.0 -> texel*0.4; (d) add a soft foot blob decal under the player, peds and cars (cookbook/decals), r 0.55 m (cars 1.2x2.4 m), strength 0.35*day + 0.2*night, so contact holds even when the map misses.

fixes.area: streets still empty in camera-locked shots
fixes.problem: street_sgt: 0 peds and 0 cars. shops: 1 parked car. LOOPS.sgt now exists, but peds.js line 93 culls with d2p < 340 measured from the PLAYER. shoot.mjs leaves the player at mends (-194,1287), about 1.9 km from St Georges Tce, so every sgt walker is hidden. Traffic follows G.focus, but T.prime rejection-samples random lanes across the whole network with only 400 tries, so few cars land in the visible 20-160 m wedge.
fixes.fix: peds.js S.update: when G.camLocked && G.focus, measure visibility from G.focus (as traffic.js does): const fx = G.camLocked && G.focus ? G.focus.x : px (same for z). Keep 340 m. traffic.js T.prime: tries 400 -> 2000. Also accept only points inside the camera frustum (Frustum.setFromProjectionMatrix, containsPoint at y+1) at 25-140 m, so the 60% front share is actually on screen.

fixes.area: shopfronts are cream light boxes with blank sign panels (regression)
fixes.problem: street_sgt shopfronts average 199,184,163, brighter than the sunlit facades above them at 17:00. The shop interior gain 0.9*lampC*(1.1+2.0*uNight) times bright rSide/rBack (0.55-0.62) times transK 0.85 gives about 0.45 daytime emissive. The fascia sign is a flat cream box (mix to vec3(0.85,0.82,0.75)*0.6), which reads as a blank placeholder. r4 read as grey glass; r5 reads as hoardings.
fixes.fix: facade.js shop room line: (1.1 + 2.0*uNight) -> (0.40 + 2.4*uNight). Shop interiors: rBack = mix(vec3(0.10,0.09,0.08), signC*0.8+0.05, 0.4) with 3 shelf bands (step(0.5, fract(hp.y*1.4))*0.5+0.5), so daytime glass shows dark merchandise, not a white room. transK shop 0.85 -> 0.70. Sign: backing vec3(0.05), plus lettering blocks lt = step(0.45, fcH(vec2(floor(vFUv.x/0.42), unit))) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.12, 0.14, sy)). Cream 0.8 albedo and the night emissive only where lt = 1.

fixes.area: night plaza flat moonlight, no lamp pools
fixes.problem: hero_night: the plaza is evenly lit edge to edge (fg 66,53,40) and peds are lit like an overcast day. The moon key at intensity 1.5 plus amax 7 drowns the lamp light-map, so the GTA night read (pools of sodium light, dark gaps, rim-lit people) is missing.
fixes.fix: daycycle.js apply(): G.sun.intensity = lerp(k.si, 1.5, m) -> lerp(k.si, 0.6, m). K el -18 amax 7 -> 5, el -8 amax 6 -> 4.5. To keep the player above the floor: uCharFill night 0.20 -> 0.24. lampReceive gain on the paver material 1.4 -> 1.8, so pools stay at today's luma.

fixes.area: night towers: grey slabs, grey-white rooms
fixes.problem: hero_night: the right tower averages 53,53,55. Lit rooms are pale grey (rSide 0.62 times a near-white lampC) arranged in long runs, and blinds (0.30*0.8) add grey bands. It reads as cream cladding, not dark glass with warm windows.
fixes.fix: facade.js: lit-room gain 0.32*lampC*(0.45+2.6*uNight) -> 0.26*lampC*(0.45+2.2*uNight). Warm lampC vec3(1.0,0.86,0.66) -> vec3(1.0,0.78,0.52) (keep 30% cool). Blind albedo when lit: 0.30*0.8 -> 0.30*mix(0.8,0.45,uNight). Night frame drop: mix(1.0,0.65,uNight) -> mix(1.0,0.45,uNight). Lit threshold 0.94-0.38*uNight -> 0.94-0.30*uNight.

fixes.problem: hero, hero_noon, hero_night: a ped (blue tank top) walks 2-3 m from the camera, fills about 45% of frame height in the left third and overlaps the player. hero_night: he is cut by the left frame edge at near-plane distance. The r5 'bias 3 eq walkers near the spawn' change put walkers on the camera line.
fixes.fix: peds.js steering (next to the d2p < 1.4 slow-down): camera bubble. If dist(ped, G.camera.position) < 3.5 m, add a lateral push away from the camera ray of (3.5-d)*0.8 m/s and set target *= 0.5. Spawn and landing loop points: reject anything within 6 m of the spawn camera (spawn minus 4.4 m along view).

fixes.area: Kings Park bald at range (third round)
fixes.problem: aerial KP is 100,101,110 and the mends hill is 119,123,135: grey-blue humps where the real scarp is a dark olive canopy (kpview). The bush floor shader still has no distance term (surfaces.js bush). Instances fade around 1.1-1.5 km and leave sand-grey.
fixes.fix: surfaces.js bush: col = mix(col, vec3(0.05,0.06,0.034)*(0.7+0.45*big), smoothstep(700.0, 1300.0, length(vWthPos - cameraPosition))); s.ao = mix(s.ao, 0.7, same); s.rough = 0.92. If vWthPos is not visible in surf(), pass a view-distance varying from the ground patch in ground.js. Zero draw calls, all tiers.

fixes.area: back-lit fill makes light clothing glow
fixes.problem: hero: the white-shirt ped is front-bright while standing against the sun. avatars.js adds max(diffuseColor.rgb, 0.09)*uCharFill as emissive, so high-albedo cloth (about 0.8) gets about 9x the lift of the dark player outfit. Light clothes look self-lit, which breaks the back-lit read.
fixes.fix: avatars.js charPatch: max(diffuseColor.rgb, vec3(0.09)) * uCharFill -> clamp(diffuseColor.rgb, vec3(0.09), vec3(0.22)) * uCharFill. The dark player keeps the full lift (player luma stays about 50); light cloth lift drops about 3.6x.

fixes.problem: The grade and env desaturation landed, and street_sgt sat fell 0.388 -> 0.288. The road is still 45,52,70 (B/R 1.56) and the shops lawn is teal 39,51,50. What is left is grazing sky specular on the asphalt (envMapIntensity 1.0 on a mid-gloss surface) plus a neutral albedo.
fixes.fix: world/index.js road material: r.color.multiplyScalar(1.7) -> r.color.setRGB(1.85,1.70,1.50) (warm WA bitumen with ironstone aggregate); r.envMapIntensity 1.0 -> 0.65. surfaces.js lawn: green vec3(0.058,0.078,0.036) -> vec3(0.062,0.078,0.032) (less teal under sky fill).

fixes.problem: street_sgt and the shops left tower are a uniform saturated blue mirror. The metallic glass albedo GL.blue [0.07,0.11,0.20] and GL.silver [0.14,0.19,0.26] tints the sky reflection, which reads as a toy colour against the bible's #4B5A6E shadow blue-grey.

Calls r4 -> r5: hero_night 848 -> 1771 (+109%), hero 1312 -> 1577, river_cbd 1683 -> 2118, kings_park 578 -> 763. Each Rocketbox ped is several skinned materials, drawn again in the shadow pass and the planar mirror.
fixes.fix: peds.js: per ped every 0.5 s, castShadow only within 45 m of G.focus (the foot blob covers the rest); userData.noReflect = true (or refl.hide) for peds beyond 35 m of the camera; root.visible culling 340 m -> 220 m on high and 140 m on low.

fixes.problem: mends, river_cbd and hero_back show uniform parallel horizontal streaks to the horizon. Real Perth Water has wind slicks and cat's-paws, calm mirror patches next to rippled bands, and in GTA VI that patchiness is what sells the water.
fixes.fix: cookbook/water/sea.js fragment: modulate the detail-wave normal amplitude with a world-space low-frequency mask: slick = mix(0.35, 1.0, smoothstep(0.35, 0.65, noise(vSeaP.xz/70.0 + t*0.01))). Apply it to the detail-normal sum and to seaLost (roughness), so calm patches mirror sharply and rough bands glitter. world/index.js waveOpts.spread 3.1 -> 2.2 for less crest alignment.

People in the hero sun patch have no 10 m streak, and the noon bench has no shadow under the seat (hero_noon). Street canyons are still blue-grey (street_sgt road 45,52,70, B/R 1.56; was 2.06).

But the moon key (1.5) lights the whole plaza evenly, so there are no lamp pools; it reads as dim daylight. Towers are grey slabs with grey-white lit rooms (hero_night tower 53,53,55), not warm windows on dark glass.

The back-lit fill makes light clothes glow: the white shirt in hero is front-lit while back-lit. A ped walks through the camera at 2-3 m (hero, hero_noon, hero_night).
